title: Operations Assistant
description:
About Us

Esfera is one of Brazil’s most prestigious product studios, operating exclusively in the U.S. market, with a strong presence in California. With over 200 projects delivered and more than $50M raised for our clients, we combine design excellence with an ultra-accelerated development process.

We work in a dynamic, collaborative environment, building high-impact digital products for global leaders such as Microsoft, Google, and Meta. If you are driven by challenges, eager to work with cutting-edge technologies, Esfera is the place for you.

As an Operations Assistant , you will act as the right hand of the COO, supporting daily operations, client communication and administrative tasks. This role is focused on organization, follow-up, communication, and research. You will help keep processes running smoothly, ensure timely communication with clients, and support decision-making through organization and research.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage the COO’s calendar and schedule meetings.
  • Handle written communication with clients (email, LinkedIn, messaging apps) in fluent business English.
  • Respond to inbound messages and follow up on conversations when needed.
  • Take meeting notes and summarize key points and action items.
  • Draft follow-up emails and internal or client-facing documents.
  • Organize files, documentation, and internal processes.
  • Conduct light research on market trends, competitors, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support day-to-day administrative and operational tasks as needed.
Requirements
  • Fluent English (written and spoken - business level).
  • Must reside in Brazil
  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience with administrative support, operations, or executive assistance.
  • Comfortable working independently and managing multiple tasks remotely.
Nice to Have
  • Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, or Virtual Assistant.
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Workspace, Notion, CRM systems, or task management tools.
  • Experience supporting founders, executives, or leadership teams.
What We Offer
  • Freelance Contract (PJ).
  • Flexible Schedule: 8 hours/day (9 AM – 1 PM BRT fixed + 4 flexible hours).
  • 100% Remote Work.
  • Annual in-person team meeting.
  • Direct Mentorship: Work closely with the COO and gain a front-row seat to scaling an international operation.

title: Product IT Sales Specialist
description:
Product Sales Specialist

Location: Hybrid (Based in Sao Paulo, Brazil)

Join Our Team and Drive Innovation in Cybersecurity!

At GM Sectec , we are seeking a Product Sales Specialist with a strong technical background and sales-oriented mindset to support our LATAM team. This role is crucial in ensuring that customers fully understand the value of our cybersecurity solutions such as: Data Discovery, Data Privacy, Secure Software Development, Cloud Security, Data Loss Prevention, etc.

The ideal candidate will be a proactive professional with a balance of technical expertise and sales acumen, capable of conducting product presentations and demonstrations, engaging with customers, and supporting and collaborating with other sales team members to win the sale.

If you have a passion for technology, customer engagement, and driving product adoption, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact!

Key Responsibilities

Technical Sales Support

  • Assist in product evaluations, guiding customers through solution capabilities and answering technical inquiries.
  • Provide expert advice on Data Discovery, Data Privacy, Secure Software Development, Cloud Security, Compliance, etc.
  • Ensure that customers fully understand the value proposition and impact of the solutions.

Sales Enablement & Product Positioning

  • Develop a deep understanding of vendor solutions, their use cases, and business value.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to position cybersecurity solutions effectively, ensuring alignment with customer needs.
  • Deliver technical presentations and demonstrations in Portuguese, English, and Spanish to showcase product capabilities.
  • Track and report sales performance and provide insights to enhance sales execution and strategy.

Proposal Development & Market Intelligence

  • Support the preparation of RFPs, RFIs, and technical documentation tailored to customer requirements.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies in LATAM.
  • Gather customer feedback to enhance product positioning and sales strategies.

Internal Collaboration & Training

  • Train internal sales teams on the key features, differentiators, and strategic use cases of vendor solutions.
  • Work closely with vendors, partners, and internal stakeholders to maintain product knowledge and best practices.
  • Drive engagement across internal teams to ensure successful product adoption and integration.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or related fields.
  • 3-5 years of experience in sales engineering/pre-sales, product management, or as a technical sales specialist within cybersecurity or technology solutions.

Technical & Sales Skills

Fluent in Portuguese (native), English, and Spanish.

Knowledge of Data Discovery, Data Privacy, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Secure Software Development, and/or Cloud Security.

Experience with RFP/RFI processes and technical proposal development.

Strong presentation, communication, and customer engagement skills.

Ability to conduct live product demonstrations and address customer concerns confidently.

Preferred Qualifications

Industry certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CISM, or CEH).

Experience working with channel partners, resellers, and vendor product sales. Ability to influence and motivate internal teams to support product positioning and adoption.

Why Join Us? Be part of a fast-growing team dedicated to delivering the best cybersecurity solutions to our clients. If you are ready to drive product adoption, support sales efforts, and engage with customers across LATAM, apply now and grow your career with GM Sectec !

title: Analista de Data Cloud Sênior - Vila Leopoldina
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Data Cloud para atuar na construção e evolução da estratégia de dados dos nossos clientes, apoiando a tomada de decisão por meio de dados integrados, confiáveis e acionáveis.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

No papel de Analista de Data Cloud você será responsável por atuar no coração da estratégia de dados dos nossos clientes, realizando a ingestão, harmonização e unificação de dados em larga escala. Você atuará no entendimento de negócio para propor arquiteturas de dados que permitam uma visão 360º do cliente, utilizando o Salesforce Data Cloud para gerar insights acionáveis e segmentações inteligentes.

Contribuirá no gerenciamento do backlog técnico, orientando o time na construção de fluxos de dados (Data Streams) e requisitos de identidade (Identity Resolution). Além disso, participará ativamente de cerimônias ágeis, garantindo que a estratégia de dados esteja alinhada aos objetivos de negócio e às boas práticas de governança.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Experiência sólida em projetos de Salesforce Data Cloud (antigo CDP);
  • Experiência com ingestão de dados (Data Streams) de diferentes fontes (Sales/Service Cloud, S3, Google Cloud, Ingestão via API);
  • Conhecimento profundo em modelagem de dados (Customer 360 Data Model);
  • Experiência na criação de regras de unificação (Identity Resolution) e campos calculados;
  • Domínio de SQL para criação de Insights Calculados e segmentações complexas;
  • Experiência com levantamento de requisitos de dados junto ao cliente;
  • Experiência com especificação de histórias de usuário técnicas voltadas a dados;
  • Capacidade de orientar o cliente na definição de KPIs e casos de uso para ativação de dados.

Você irá se destacar se:

  • Certificação Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant;
  • Conhecimentos em Marketing Cloud Engagement (ativação de segmentos);
  • Experiência com integração de dados via MuleSoft ou outras ferramentas de ETL;
  • Conhecimento em Tableau ou Inteligência Artificial (Einstein) aplicada ao Data Cloud.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;

Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo .

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)

$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position

About the Company

Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.

Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.

You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.

The Role

As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:

  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills

Who You Are

  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix
  • A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies
  • A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group

Why You’ll Love It Here

✅ Work fully remote from anywhere

✅ Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month

✅ Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base

✅ Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)

✅ Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks

✅ Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

title: Analista de Excelência Operacional II
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Gestão e Mapeamento de Processos: Realizar o mapeamento de processos ponta a ponta (AS-IS e TO-BE), identificando gargalos, redundâncias e oportunidades de otimização utilizando metodologias de processos e fluxogramas funcionais;
  • Padronização e Governança: Elaborar, revisar e gerir procedimentos da área de excelência operacional, garantindo que a documentação reflita a realidade da operação e as melhores práticas de Melhoria Contínua;
  • Gestão de Capacitação: Administrar a matriz de treinamentos técnicos e a gestão de LUPs (Lições de Um Ponto), garantindo a retenção do conhecimento e o nivelamento técnico das equipes;
  • Desenvolvimento de Conteúdo: Construir e ministrar treinamentos técnicos sobre ferramentas da qualidade, pilares de TPM e metodologias de análise de processos;
  • Gestão de Times de Alto Desempenho (TAD): Manter a governança das informações dos integrantes dos Times de Alto Desempenho, monitorando a evolução da maturidade e competências dos grupos;
  • Auditorias de Processo: Gerir e executar o cronograma de auditorias internas de TPM em QEC para assegurar o cumprimento dos padrões estabelecidos e a aderência às ferramentas de excelência operacional;
  • Análise de Dados e Projetos: Coletar e analisar dados para suportar a resolução de problemas complexos e suportar o desenvolvimento de projetos de melhoria de baixa/média complexidade;
  • Suporte Técnico: Atuar como facilitador interno, auxiliando as áreas na aplicação de ferramentas de análise de causa raiz e gestão de indicadores.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Química ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência sólida em mapeamento de processos, estruturação de fluxos de trabalho e análise de causa raiz;
  • Domínio de ferramentas da Qualidade e Melhoria Contínua (Ishikawa, 5 Porquês, PDCA, 5S, Kaizen);
  • Alta capacidade analítica
  • Habilidade para construção de apresentações e exposição das suas ideias;
  • Flexibilidade a mudanças e cenários dinâmicos;
  • Capacidade de organização e priorização;
  • Perfil comunicativo com boa negociação e influência;
  • Proatividade, colaboratividade e trabalho em equipe;

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prática com o pilar TPM Office e mapeamento via Makigami;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de modelagem de processos (Visio, Bizagi ou similares);
  • Certificação Lean Six Sigma (Yellow ou Green Belt) com aplicação de projetos DMAIC;
  • Habilidade na criação de dashboards (Tableau ou Looker).
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas Google e DataPrep

Modelo: Hibrido na região de Curitiba.

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.

Our promise to you:

-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry

What we ask of you:

-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness

As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.

Who we are:

We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.

With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.

Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.

About the job:

The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the São Paulo airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.

Operational Management:

  • Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.

Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
  • Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory); Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
  • Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
  • Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de priorização.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Analista JR/PL de Midia Performance
description:
***Vaga híbrida***

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Mídia Analytics com perfil estratégico para ser o elo entre os dados de campanha e as decisões de negócio. Sua missão será mergulhar na performance das diferentes plataformas de mídia, avaliar a estratégia do cliente e gerar insights acionáveis que otimizem o investimento e maximizem os resultados.

Importante: Esta não é uma vaga de operação ou gestão de campanhas (mídia paga). Sua função será a de ser extrair inteligência dos dados e análise para orientar o time de operações e a estratégia do cliente.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Análise de Performance Multicanal: Extrair dados e contribuir com as análises sobre a performance das campanhas em diversas plataformas (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, DV360), consolidando dados para criar uma visão holística dos resultados.

Avaliação de Estratégia de Mídia: Auditar a estratégia de mídia atual do cliente, comparando os resultados com as melhores práticas do mercado, benchmarks do setor e os objetivos de negócio estabelecidos.

Conhecimento Técnico das Plataformas (Visão Analítica): Possuir conhecimento das principais plataformas de mídia, não para operá-las, mas para compreender suas métricas, dimensões, modelos de atribuição, lógicas de leilão e possibilidades de extração de dados para análises robustas.

Dashboards e Relatórios: Desenvolver e manter dashboards em ferramentas como Looker Studio ou Power BI que traduzam dados complexos em KPIs claros e acionáveis para o cliente e para as equipes internas.

Estudos de Mercado e Benchmarking: Pesquisar e analisar o cenário competitivo, trazendo insights sobre o comportamento da concorrência e as tendências do mercado para enriquecer a estratégia.

Apresentação de Resultados: Comunicar de forma clara e persuasiva os resultados das análises, os insights gerados e as recomendações estratégicas para stakeholders, incluindo gerentes, diretores e o próprio cliente.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Obrigatórios:

Experiência Comprovada: Experiência prévia em análise de performance de mídia digital, seja em agência, consultoria ou em um time de marketing de cliente.

Proficiência Analítica nas Plataformas de Mídia: Conhecimento avançado dos conceitos, configurações, métricas e dimensões das principais plataformas:

Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max)

Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram)

TikTok Ads

LinkedIn Ads

DV360

Perfil Analítico e Estratégico: Habilidade comprovada para interpretar dados, identificar tendências, formular hipóteses e transformar números em narrativas e planos de ação.

Excelentes Habilidades com Ferramentas de Análise e Visualização: Domínio de planilhas (Excel / Google Sheets) e experiência sólida na criação de relatórios e dashboards (Looker Studio é um forte diferencial).

Comunicação Excepcional: Capacidade de apresentar ideias complexas de forma simples e direta, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito.

Diferenciais (Serão considerados um plus):

Conhecimento em Google Analytics 4 (GA4) para conectar a performance de mídia com o comportamento no site.

Noções de SQL para extração e cruzamento de dados de diferentes fontes.

Experiência com Ad Servers como Campaign Manager 360 (CM360).

Familiaridade com outras plataformas de mídia (ex: Pinterest Ads, Twitter/X Ads, etc.).

Conhecimento sobre modelos de atribuição e estudos de Media Mix Modeling (MMM).

description:

We are looking for a Domain Architect Operations Technology , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, Remote , in the city of Belo Horizonte.

Job Description:

The Domain Architect – Operation Technology is fundamental to the architecture, governance and evolution of operational technology solutions and infrastructures in the mining operations of Brasil and Canada. This professional will lead the integration of traditional OT systems (SCADA, DCS, PLCs) with emerging technologies of industrial IoT, industrial cloud, advanced automation and OT cybersecurity.

Its mission is to ensure safe, resilient, integrated industrial operations aligned with global digital strategy, supporting innovations in mining 4.0, sustainability, operational efficiency and digital transformation. He will work collaboratively with technical, security, IT and business areas at the multinational level.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and govern OT architectures , ensuring alignment between industrial systems, automation, IoT sensors and integration with IT and Cloud.
  • Design solutions for real-time control, monitoring, automation and analysis of industrial processes, ensuring high availability and resilience.
  • Lead modernization projects, edge/cloud OT integration, digital twins, predictive analytics, cognitive automation, and operational security.
  • Assess and implement global OT security standards (NIST, IEC 62443), vulnerability management, and industrial cyber incident response.
  • Foster alignment between OT and IT teams to promote secure, efficient, and scalable integration of operational technologies.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, contingency plans, operational guides, and OT governance policies.
  • Participate in the definition of strategies for technological innovation, sustainability and reduction of environmental impact.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and strategic partners on critical OT solutions, ensuring system interoperability.
  • Train technical teams and promote a culture of safety and OT innovation in global operations.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Fluent English for global communication between Brazil-Canada work.
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Computing, Industrial Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in architecture, engineering, or operational technology leadership in industrial or mining sectors.
  • In-depth knowledge of OT systems: SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, IoT sensors, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, Profibus).
  • Expertise in OT/IT integration, edge computing architectures, digital twins, advanced automation, predictive analytics and Industrial Big Data.
  • Solid domain in OT cybersecurity, IEC 62443 frameworks, NIST, incident management and operational continuity.
  • Knowledge in industrial cloud platforms (Azure IoT, AWS IoT, Google Cloud Industrial) and OT modernization.

title: Supervisor(a) de Peças
description:
Somos o Grupo SADA!

Um grupo referência em transporte e logística, além de atuação em diversos segmentos de negócios movidos por milhares de pessoas dispostas a darem o seu melhor, todos os dias. Somos serviços, informação, indústria, concessionárias, energia limpa, esporte e responsabilidade social movimentando a vida das pessoas há mais de 45 anos, e é isso que nos faz ir mais longe.

Venha para uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil. Uma empresa que cuida das pessoas e se preocupa em proporcionar um ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais saudável e seguro, pois queremos que nossos colaboradores sempre sintam orgulho de trabalhar aqui.

Somos plurais por natureza, um grupo diverso em negócios e pessoas. Acreditamos que as diferenças somam e movimentam, e é por isso que o Grupo SADA quer conhecer você. Todas as nossas vagas são extensivas as Pessoas com Deficiência e profissionais reabilitados do INSS. Quem sabe alguma oportunidade combina com você.

Supervisor(a) de Peças

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) de Peças para se juntar à nossa equipe na Deva Veículos . Para liderar o time de vendas e estoque, garantindo eficiência operacional, excelência no atendimento e alcance dos resultados do setor.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar a equipe de vendas e estoque, distribuindo tarefas e acompanhando o desempenho das atividades;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das metas de vendas, margem e indicadores de desempenho do setor;
  • Apoiar e orientar a equipe no atendimento a clientes, negociação e elaboração de orçamentos;
  • Acompanhar pedidos de compra e vendas, assegurando a entrega correta e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Controlar indicadores de satisfação de clientes e propor melhorias nos processos de atendimento;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e participar do planejamento de campanhas e estratégias comerciais;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas internas, políticas de garantia, devoluções e procedimentos de qualidade;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental da equipe, incentivando treinamentos e boas práticas;
  • Acompanhar equipe no preenchimento do CRM voltado para Peças.

Pré-requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo; desejável formação técnica ou superior em Administração, Logística, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência anterior em supervisão de vendas e/ou gestão de estoque de peças automotivas ou pesadas.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de estoque, indicadores de desempenho e controle de metas.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office e experiência com sistemas de gestão de peças (ERP).
  • Boa capacidade de liderança, comunicação e tomada de decisão.
  • Perfil organizado, com foco em resultados e visão estratégica.

NOSSA HISTÓRIA

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.

Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A é criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.

Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente.

“Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.

Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana:

TRADIÇÃO EM CRESCER

Apesar das dificuldades políticas e econômicas da época, a empresa estabeleceu uma tradição em crescer, valorizando o trabalho em equipe e as habilidades individuais dos colaboradores em um ambiente onde todos se sentem orgulhosos de construir uma história de solidez e grandes conquistas.

title: International Treasury Specialist
description:
Forno de Minas is a leading Brazilian food company with a strong heritage, recognized brands, and a growing international footprint. As the company expands its operations in the U.S. and Europe, financial governance, liquidity control, and operational excellence are critical to sustaining growth. We offer a collaborative environment with high exposure, autonomy, and direct interaction with senior leadership.

About the role

This is a highly specialized international treasury role , designed for a senior, autonomous professional.

The International Treasury Specialist will operate independently , owning treasury, cash flow, and international banking operations across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe .

This is not a transactional AP role .

It is a position with low payment volume but very high operational and compliance complexity , requiring strong judgment, technical depth, and end-to-end ownership.

Key responsibilities

Cash Flow & Liquidity Management

  • Build, manage, and continuously monitor short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts (including 13-week cash flow)
  • Ensure liquidity and funding availability for international operations
  • Analyze variances, assumptions, and scenarios impacting cash position

International Payments & Banking Operations

  • Execute and manage international payments across U.S. and European banking systems
  • Operate payment methods such as ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, wire transfers , and international payroll-related payments
  • Navigate banking environments without PIX or boletos
  • Manage FX transactions, payment cut-offs, bank holidays, and country-specific rules
  • Maintain strong relationships with international banks and service providers
  • Negotiate banking fees and service conditions when applicable

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Governance

  • Own the end-to-end international AP and AR flows, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness
  • Partner with Accounting and local providers (e.g., Portugal accounting team) for validation and execution
  • Ensure payments align with accounting, tax, and contractual requirements
  • Apply strong governance, internal controls, and compliance standards

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Work closely with HR (international payrolls and benefits), Marketing (costs and campaigns), Accounting , FP&A , and Commercial
  • Understand accounting classifications (OPEX vs. CAPEX) and financial impacts
  • Act as a key finance partner in international operations

Profile we are looking for

  • A senior, autonomous, and highly reliable professional
  • Comfortable operating alone , without constant follow-ups
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Able to manage complex international routines with precision
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and resilient in a corporate governance environment
  • Strong communication skills to interact with global stakeholders

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related fields
  • Fluent English (mandatory / non-negotiable)
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Treasury or International Finance
  • Proven experience with international payments , especially in the U.S.
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow management (build, monitor, analyze)
  • Strong understanding of financial mathematics
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP and/or Datasul – TOTVS)
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance and compliance

Nice to have

  • Experience with European banking operations
  • Spanish proficiency
  • Prior exposure to multinational or international business environments

Why join Forno de Minas

  • Strategic international role with high visibility
  • Opportunity to build and structure international treasury operations
  • High level of autonomy and trust
  • Direct interaction with senior leadership
  • Exposure to global financial operations and decision-making

o Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, C++, C, Python).

o Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

title: Manufacturing Quality and Aftersales Specialist
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role:

As a Manufacturing Quality and Aftersales Specialist, you will play a vital role in our commitment to implementing best practices in quality control. This position is dedicated to ensuring the highest quality standards in our products through collaboration with suppliers, monitoring quality processes, and enhancing our aftersales services. Your contributions will not only enhance our products and services but also strengthen positive relationships with our customers. Job Description:

  • Collaborate with suppliers to establish clear quality expectations and standards for components and materials.

  • Monitor the quality processes for incoming materials, documenting and analyzing relevant data and processes.
  • Manage warranty processes with suppliers, including the preparation and submission of technical reports, claims, and supporting documentation.
  • Create detailed  re ports on product quality metrics and supplier performance, identifying trends and opportunities for enhancement.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to communicate findings and recommend actions that improve product quality and customer satisfaction.

Hard Skills:

  • Experience in quality assurance, supplier management, or a related field within manufacturing or the automotive industry.
  • Proficiency in quality management systems and reporting tools that facilitate effective data analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess product performance and identify recurring quality issues.
  • Advanced English proficiency for effective drafting and communication.

Soft Skills:

  • Highly Disciplined:  Demonstrates a strong commitment to accuracy, organization, and consistency in all tasks.
  • Process-Oriented Thinking:  Employs systematic thinking to analyze workflows and enhance problem-solving capabilities, ensuring efficiency in processes.
  • Attention to Detail:  Conducts thorough evaluations of supplier quality and product performance, focusing on delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • Effective Communication Skills:  Communicates clearly and concisely with stakeholders, fostering collaboration and mutual understanding across teams.

title: Analista Contábil Pleno
description:
Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!

Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

Com quase 50 anos de história, presente em mais de 30 países e com mais de 170.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece Soluções Integradas de Segurança, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!

Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora

Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro/ Cash e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO.

* Vaga aberta a pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Se você é PCD e possui os requisitos e interesse , junte-se à nossa equipe de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo e venha ser Protagonista de uma história de sucesso!

ATIVIDADES A SEREM DESENVOLVIDAS

  • Executar as diversas atividades de fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual das companhias Prosegur Brasil, conforme do cronograma de fechamento global da Companhia;
  • Analisar e conciliar contas patrimoniais e de resultado, garantindo consistência e acurácia das informações;
  • Conduzir análises de variação de contas patrimoniais e de resultado, propondo ajustes, melhorias de performance e fornecendo justificativas robustas para variações;
  • Elaborar e/ou participar da elaboração das demonstrações financeiras completas conforme IFRS, assegurando precisão e aderência às normas locais e corporativas;
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo suporte técnico e documentação de suporte;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos contábeis e controles internos.

REQUISITOS IMPRESCINDÍVEIS PARA A INSCRIÇÃO

  • Graduação completa/ em curso em Ciências Contábeis.
  • Experiência consolidada na área contábil, com atuação em fechamento contábil, conciliações contábeis e demais processos inerentes à área.
  • Conhecimento em CPC/IFRS.
  • Domínio de Excel em nível intermediário a avançado.
  • Vivência com sistemas ERP (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS ou similares).

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Experiência no atendimento à auditoria externa.
  • Espanhol intermediário ou avançado.

Perfil Comportamental:

  • Visão global e capacidade de atuar em ambiente multicultural;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos curtos e múltiplas demandas;
  • Boa comunicação, clareza na transmissão de informações e postura consultiva;
  • Raciocínio analítico e atenção a detalhes;

title: Operations Manager
description:
About the Role:

A growing international betting operator is seeking a results-driven and highly structured Deputy Operations Manager to support the expansion of their retail sports betting operations in Brazil. Based in João Pessoa , this leadership position will play a critical role in implementing operational strategies, managing cross-functional support teams, and ensuring consistent service delivery across multiple sites. The role combines oversight of technology deployment, logistics, procurement, facilities, compliance, and security operations in a fast-paced and regulated industry.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Operational Leadership & Execution
  • Assist in executing the national operational roadmap under the guidance of senior leadership.
  • Manage daily operations across retail locations, including POS, agent networks, and kiosks.
  • Supervise infrastructure setup and ensure systems and devices operate efficiently at all sites.
  • Coordinate interdepartmental efforts to align with business goals and maintain continuity.
  • Technology & Systems Integration
  • Oversee local deployment of technical solutions and platforms.
  • Lead integrations with payment providers, CPF verification systems, and compliance APIs.
  • Ensure systems meet national standards and regulatory certifications (e.g., GLI 13/16/33, LOTEP).
  • Monitor system reliability, data integrity, and uptime across operational platforms.
  • Procurement, Logistics & Import Operations
  • Lead end-to-end logistics, from supplier management and purchasing to customs compliance.
  • Authorize procurement activities within established approval frameworks.
  • Handle supplier negotiations to secure cost-effective, high-quality services.
  • Manage importation processes, ensuring all materials meet legal and regulatory standards.
  • Inventory, Warehousing & Dispatch
  • Monitor inventory levels and material flow across all operational hubs.
  • Enforce warehouse protocols for receiving, storing, and distributing goods.
  • Maintain accurate records and traceability for stock and movement control.
  • Fleet, Facilities & Maintenance
  • Oversee vehicle availability, usage, and preventive maintenance for operational fleets.
  • Supervise construction, renovation, and ongoing maintenance of physical locations.
  • Manage upkeep of generators, HVAC systems, power supply, and core IT infrastructure.
  • Ensure contractors meet quality, time, and cost expectations.
  • Safety, Security & Risk Mitigation
  • Lead on-site physical security efforts, including guards, access control, and patrols.
  • Ensure adherence to fire safety and workplace safety standards.
  • Respond to and document incidents related to theft, vandalism, or other safety breaches.
  • Conduct regular audits of safety protocols and asset protection measures.
  • Compliance & Internal Controls
  • Enforce operational policies aligned with AML, KYC, LGPD, and internal control standards.
  • Support audits by providing necessary operational records and data.
  • Track and report performance metrics around operational efficiency and system uptime.
  • Generate detailed reports for leadership and headquarters.
  • Team Leadership & Development
  • Supervise cross-functional teams in operations, logistics, security, and maintenance.
  • Collaborate with HR to address staffing needs, performance management, and training.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous process improvement.

Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, IT, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 7 years’ experience in operations or logistics, ideally in gaming, fintech, retail, or similarly regulated sectors.
  • Demonstrated success managing import processes, supplier relations, and inventory systems.
  • Hands-on experience with rolling out technology solutions and managing infrastructure in the field.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian compliance standards including LOTEP, LGPD, AML/KYC, and GLI certifications.
  • Strong financial skills with a focus on budget control and cost efficiency.
  • Fluent in both Portuguese and English.
  • Proven leadership ability and organizational skills in a multi-site, fast-growth environment.
  • Highly detail-oriented, execution-focused, and adaptable under pressure.

title: UX Researcher (Mid-Level)
description:
We are looking for a curious, empathetic, and data-driven UX Researcher to join our team at Edward Martin. With at least 3 years of experience, you will be the bridge between our users and our product strategy. You will lead end-to-step research initiatives—from defining the problem to delivering actionable insights that influence design and engineering.

The ideal candidate is a master of qualitative methods, particularly In-Depth Interviews (IDIs) , and has a proven track record of synthesizing complex data into Personas and Critical User Journeys (CUJs) .

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Research: Lead the planning, recruitment, execution, and analysis of qualitative research studies.
  • Qualitative Mastery: Conduct high-impact IDIs to uncover deep-seated user needs, pain points, and motivations.
  • Strategic Artifacts: Translate raw data into foundational design tools, including robust User Personas and detailed Critical User Journeys (CUJs) that map the user’s path across touchpoints.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with Product Designers and Product Managers to identify research gaps and ensure findings are integrated into the product roadmap.
  • Insight Evangelism: Present findings through compelling storytelling to stakeholders, moving beyond "what happened" to "why it matters" and "what we should do next."
  • Research tool: Familiar with research tools such as UserTesting, Dscout, Qualtrics, Google Drive, etc.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a UX Researcher or Product Researcher.
  • Expertise in qualitative methodologies , specifically moderating interviews and conducting thematic analysis.
  • Proven ability to map Critical User Journeys that highlight friction points and opportunities.
  • Experience building and maintaining User Personas that are used by cross-functional teams to make decisions.
  • Portfolio or case studies demonstrating how your research directly impacted a product's direction.
  • Fluent in English, with excellent communication skills for both research and share-out purposes.

Preferred "Plus" Skills

  • Quantitative Proficiency: Experience designing, launching, and analyzing quantitative surveys to validate qualitative findings or measure user sentiment at scale.

Who You Are

  • You are a critical thinker who doesn't just take requests but asks "What is the core question we are trying to answer?"
  • You are an excellent communicator who can tailor your delivery to both designers and executives.
  • You are organized and capable of managing multiple research workstreams simultaneously.

title: Senior Front-End Engineer
description:
Role Overview

Our client is looking for a Senior Front-End Engineer to take ownership of their web platform and help define the next generation of user experience across the entire product catalog. This is a lead role for a self-starter who thrives in a startup environment, enjoys building beautifully engineered products, and knows how to translate AI and computer vision outputs into compelling visual experiences.

In this role, you’ll work directly with the Head of Product, the Design team, and Engineering teams to improve and expand the existing Inspection Platform, while leading front-end development for upcoming features across the broader product suite. You’ll collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers, bring your own ideas to the table, and be expected to leverage modern AI coding tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) to accelerate development, productivity, and testing.

You’ll also play a key role in shaping the user experience and human-centered design efforts as the platform evolves. This includes working closely with customers to gather feedback, validate workflows, and continuously improve usability across the product. Strong experience collaborating deeply with designers is essential.

As the front-end owner across the company, you’ll be responsible for defining and maintaining front-end frameworks, tooling, and workflows, establishing best practices, and organizing a reusable, well-documented component library. Your work will enable other front-end engineers to efficiently leverage existing patterns and components as the team grows. This is an ideal role for someone who wants to be the go-to front-end leader at a growing AI startup.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the front-end development and evolution of our client’s product suite

Lead front-end UI development and ensure consistency across multiple products

Translate AI and computer vision outputs (segmentation masks, bounding boxes, JSON metadata) into rich, high-performance web visualizations

Build, maintain, and document a component library using ShadCN, Radix UI, Tailwind, and Storybook in collaboration with visual designers

Collaborate daily with backend engineers and designers to ensure usability, scalability, and design consistency

Work closely with backend and ML teams to integrate APIs, model outputs, and data pipelines into the front-end experience

Bring creative ideas to improve UX and developer experience, from prototyping new views to optimizing rendering performance

Leverage AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) to increase velocity, improve test coverage, and enhance code quality

Participate in roadmap planning, scoping sessions, and internal reviews as the front-end lead

Partner closely with the Design team to apply human-centered design principles and ensure workflows are intuitive and grounded in real customer needs

Participate in and help run customer-facing UAT sessions alongside design and product teams

Translate customer feedback and usability findings into concrete front-end improvements and iterative design enhancements

Support visual design execution when appropriate, ensuring high-quality UI implementation aligned with product and brand standards

Minimum Qualifications

7+ years of front-end development experience; 2+ years in a senior or lead role preferred

Deep expertise in React (Next.js) and TypeScript

Proven ability to integrate and visualize AI/ML outputs (JSON metadata, segmentation, bounding boxes, etc.) in scalable web interfaces

Experience solving Google Maps–style visualization challenges, including zoom logic and dynamic repositioning of text, icons, and overlays

Strong experience with Tailwind, Radix UI, ShadCN, and Storybook

Excellent collaboration skills and comfort working directly with product and design teams

Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced startup environment

Strong understanding of human-centered design principles

Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with cross-functional teams and customers

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with GIS platforms such as ArcGIS (ESRI)

Background in computer vision or AI-powered SaaS products

Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure) and backend API integration

Active use of AI development tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Cursor, etc.)

Experience defining or contributing to design systems

Passion for building products with real-world impact (climate resilience, infrastructure safety, etc.)

Hands-on experience with UX research, usability testing, or customer research

Visual design experience or strong UI sensibility (not required, but a big plus)

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field required

A Master’s degree is preferred but not required; equivalent practical experience and a strong portfolio of shipped products are equally valued

Work Environment

Our client is a remote-first company, with a primary base in Los Angeles, CA. They support flexible remote work, allowing team members to work from wherever they are most productive. At the same time, they value in-person connection and host multiple all-hands offsite meetings each year to foster collaboration and team cohesion. The environment balances remote flexibility with in-person moments that matter, supporting a connected and high-performing global team.

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!

  • Ensino Superior em andamento completo
  • Experiência na área de vendas
  • Conhecimento e vivência com gestão de times, visando engajamento e motivação

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

title: Stylist
description:
Vaga: Stylist

Local: Escritório Lapa – São Paulo/SP | 100% Presencial

✨ Chegou a sua hora de dar forma, caimento e desejo ao produto!

Na Centauro, cada detalhe importa. O styling é um pilar fundamental para garantir que o produto chegue ao cliente com máxima fidelidade, estética e impacto visual. Da passadoria ao ajuste final no set, tudo precisa estar impecável antes do clique.

Buscamos um(a) Stylist com olhar contemporâneo, senso estético apurado e perfil mão na massa , para atuar diretamente no estúdio fotográfico, sendo o braço direito da fotografia e garantindo que cada peça seja apresentada com perfeição — seja no corpo do modelo ou no still.

Seus desafios no jogo:

  • Montagem de Looks: Criar composições para fotos de catálogo e campanhas, respeitando o DNA da marca, as tendências de moda e os objetivos comerciais de cada coleção;
  • Preparação de Produtos: Garantir que todas as peças estejam em perfeito estado para a fotografia, realizando passadoria/vaporização técnica, organização e etiquetagem correta;
  • Acompanhamento em Set: Atuar ativamente durante o shooting, ajustando o caimento das roupas no modelo com uso de alfinetes, grampos e clipes, assegurando simetria, fluidez e estética impecável;
  • Styling de Still e Produto: Zelar pela apresentação do produto em fotos fora do corpo, garantindo volume, forma e alinhamento visual;
  • Curadoria de Acessórios: Selecionar, organizar e controlar o acervo de calçados e acessórios que complementam os looks;
  • Gestão de Amostras: Controlar entrada e saída de peças, garantindo cumprimento do cronograma de fotos, sem faltas, trocas ou avarias;
  • Interface com Pós-Produção: Alinhar o que deve ser resolvido no set versus ajustes digitais, contribuindo para eficiência e qualidade final da imagem.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Formação superior completa (desejável formação em Moda, Design de Moda, Produção de Moda ou áreas correlatas );
  • Experiência prévia em estúdios de e-commerce de moda , fotografia de catálogo ou grandes produções;
  • Forte repertório de moda , com domínio de tendências, composição de cores, silhuetas e proporções;
  • Olhar técnico apurado para identificar e corrigir rapidamente defeitos de caimento;
  • Agilidade, organização e familiaridade com fluxos de alto volume em estúdio;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com habilidade para trabalhar em sintonia com fotógrafos, modelos e times criativos;
  • Atenção extrema aos detalhes e senso crítico antes, durante e após o shooting.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Domínio avançado de técnicas de ajuste (pinning) para diferentes tamanhos e tipos de peças;
  • Conhecimento profundo em preparação têxtil , entendendo fibras, tecidos e técnicas corretas de vaporização;
  • Noções sólidas de colorimetria , para compor looks harmoniosos com fundo, luz e identidade visual;
  • Experiência com Ghost Mannequin, still de produto e enchimentos técnicos ;
  • Capacidade de analisar proporção e silhueta, garantindo protagonismo da peça-chave;
  • Vivência em controle de SKUs, planilhas e apoio à logística de coleções;
  • Habilidade em orientar modelos em movimentos e poses que valorizem o caimento dos tecidos.

O que você encontra por aqui:

  • Estúdio profissional com alto volume de produção;
  • Atuação direta e integrada com fotografia, estilo, comercial e e-commerce;
  • Autonomia para contribuir com melhorias visuais e de processo;
  • Contato com grandes marcas e categorias esportivas;
  • Ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e orientado à excelência;
  • Oportunidade real de crescimento e desenvolvimento em um ecossistema forte de e-commerce.

title: Regional People and Culture Director
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

PLAN INTERNATIONAL – Regional People & Culture Director (Americas & Caribbean)

Location: Peru, Ecuador, Paraguay, Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Dominican Republic, Mexico, Colombia, Brazil

Languages: Fluent English & Spanish (written and spoken) – English is non-negotiable

Type of contract: Local – Plan International

Contract: Permanent

Reports to: Regional Deputy Director

About Plan International

Plan International is a global humanitarian and development organization, active for over 85 years in more than 80 countries, dedicated to advancing children’s rights and gender equality, with a strong focus on girls most affected by poverty, discrimination, and violence.

The Role

Plan International is seeking a Regional People & Culture Director (RP&CD) to provide strategic leadership to the People & Culture function across the Americas and the Caribbean Region .

This role is a senior regional leadership position responsible for driving One P&C : ensuring consistent implementation of global People & Culture strategy while appropriately contextualizing it to diverse country environments, cultures, and employment frameworks.

The RP&CD is a core member of the Regional Management Team and the Global People & Culture Leadership Team , partnering closely with the Regional Director to strengthen organizational culture, leadership effectiveness, change management, and overall performance through people.

This is a true regional leadership role . Applicants must demonstrate experience overseeing people functions across multiple countries , not only providing advisory or project-based support.

What We’re Looking For (Please read carefully)

We encourage applications only from candidates who can demonstrate strength across all areas below :

A. Senior Regional People & Culture Leadership (Essential)

• 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in HR / People & Culture at senior level

• Proven experience leading people strategy in large, complex, geographically dispersed organizations

• Demonstrated ability to support and influence Country Directors and senior leadership teams

• Experience working within global or international organizations (NGO experience strongly preferred)

B. Strategic Thinking & Change Leadership (Non-Negotiable)

• Strong strategic mindset , able to translate global strategy into regional and country-level priorities

• Proven experience leading organizational change , culture transformation, and leadership behaviours

• Ability to work in ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and lead in fast-paced, multicultural environments

C. People Analytics, Systems & Data (Critical Capability)

• Strong data literacy : ability to analyze, interpret, and communicate people data to support decision-making

• Experience using HR systems, dashboards, and analytics to inform workforce planning and talent decisions

• Comfort leveraging digital tools and systems to improve executional excellence

D. Leadership, Communication & Influence

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels

• Strong stakeholder management across regional, country, and global teams

• Ability to model Plan International’s values, feminist leadership principles, and inclusive behaviors

Key Responsibilities (Summary)

• Provide strategic leadership for People & Culture across the region, ensuring alignment with global P&C strategy

• Strengthen P&C capability and capacity in Country and Cluster Offices through matrix leadership

• Lead regional talent management, succession planning, and strategic workforce planning

• Champion inclusive culture, staff wellbeing, employee engagement, and feminist leadership principles

• Drive data-informed decision-making through people analytics and systems

• Ensure robust People & Culture processes in humanitarian response contexts

• Ensure full compliance with safeguarding, gender equality, inclusion, and ethical standards

Essential Requirements

• Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, or related field

• Fluency in English and Spanish (written and spoken)

• Strong business acumen and customer-focused mindset

• High integrity and commitment to safeguarding, equity, and inclusion

Desirable

• French language skills

• Experience in international NGOs or humanitarian settings

• Experience in end-to-end HR process design

• Strong affinity with technology and digital transformation

Application Process

• Applications and CVs must be submitted in English

• Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a formal application through Plan International’s recruitment platform

Application deadline: February 2nd, 2026

Commitment to Equality, Diversity & Safeguarding

Equality, diversity and inclusion are at the heart of everything Plan International stands for. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, empowered and able to contribute fully.

Plan International operates with zero tolerance for abuse, exploitation, or harassment of any kind. Pre-employment checks will be conducted in line with our Safeguarding Children and Young People policy and the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme.

description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP).
